<!--
This template backs the report link wikicommit-banner generates on every
published page (WikiCommitBanner.tsx). That link already pre-fills the title
(page type + title) and the body (page URL, language, and the guidance
repeated under "Problem" below), so if you got here through that link you
likely just need to describe the problem.

If you opened this template directly instead, please fill in the page URL and
language yourself. The prompts under "Problem" are the short version of what
that link pre-fills. They live there rather than only here because this file
is one per repository and has no language of its own, so a reader arriving
from a Japanese page would otherwise be prompted in English.

The `wikicommit-report` label deliberately differs from the `wikicommit-review`
label used by WikiCommit's own review-tracking Issues, so the two never get
confused with each other.
-->

## Page

<!-- URL or .wikicommit/entity/<lang>/<Type>/<slug>.md path of the affected page -->

## Problem

<!--
What's wrong, and what you'd expect instead.

These are the kinds of problem no automated check can find, which makes them
the most useful to hear about. You are not being asked to go looking — only to
say what you noticed while reading:

- Anything about a real person or organization that felt overstated or too certain
- Anything that conflicts with what you know (add a URL if you have one)
- Anything another page on this wiki says differently

Anything else is welcome too — typos, stale facts, broken links.
-->
